tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to pass on, advance, go on, pass by, remove
1a) (Qal) to pass on, put on
1b) (Hiphil) to remove
Aramaic equivalent: a.dah (עֲדָה "to pass on/over/away" H5709)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to advance, i.e. pass on or continue; causatively, to remove; specifically, to bedeck (i.e. bring an ornament upon)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: adorn, deck (self), pass by, take away.
